name: dv_textnode_write
description: Write the whole Markdown text of a text node as its next version; a new path starts at version 1. A text node holds planning text such as a script, story beats or an ad spec. base_version is the version you read, so you never overwrite a version you have not read; 0 for a new path. For a small change to a long text, call dv_textnode_edit instead.

path.description: The text node, as a relative path such as beats.md or episodes/ep001/script.md (no whitespace, @, # or .., no leading /, no empty or . part).

body.description: The complete Markdown text of the new version.

title.description: The title; defaults to the previous title, else the first heading, else the path.

base_version.description: The version you last read (`version` in dv_proj_state `texts` or in the dv_textnode_read report); 0 for a new text node. The call is refused when the text node has another version.

from.description: The paths of the text nodes this version was built from, such as the beats a script follows; a later version of one of them marks this version stale. Omit it to keep the sources of the previous version; [] for none.

reason.description: Why you call this, in the user's words or your own summary; recorded as the intent of the record.

project_id.description: The project; defaults to this conversation's project from dv_proj_create or dv_proj_open.

inputs.description: Input references by role: <asset> (an asset ID), <record>#<output> (an output of an earlier record), or <id>@<version> (a character, location or style version; dv_proj_state lists IDs); a list for roles marked []. Roles: source?: text[].

supersedes.description: Records whose outputs this call replaces, such as an earlier take; their consumers become stale.

based_on.description: The record this call is a changed copy of; the takes of one original share it.

name: dv_textnode_edit
description: Change a text node by literal replacements and write the result as its next version. The edits apply in order; each old_text must occur exactly once in the text, so copy it from dv_textnode_read without the line numbers and add neighboring lines when it repeats. When any edit does not apply, nothing is written. base_version is the version you read.

path.description: The text node, as a relative path such as beats.md or episodes/ep001/script.md (no whitespace, @, # or .., no leading /, no empty or . part).

new_text.description: Its replacement; empty to delete it.

base_version.description: The version you last read (`version` in dv_proj_state `texts` or in the dv_textnode_read report); 0 for a new text node. The call is refused when the text node has another version.

reason.description: Why you call this, in the user's words or your own summary; recorded as the intent of the record.

project_id.description: The project; defaults to this conversation's project from dv_proj_create or dv_proj_open.

inputs.description: Input references by role: <asset> (an asset ID), <record>#<output> (an output of an earlier record), or <id>@<version> (a character, location or style version; dv_proj_state lists IDs); a list for roles marked []. Roles: source?: text[].

supersedes.description: Records whose outputs this call replaces, such as an earlier take; their consumers become stale.

based_on.description: The record this call is a changed copy of; the takes of one original share it.

name: dv_textnode_read
description: Read a text node with line numbers: the whole text, or one section (a heading and its lines up to the next heading of the same or a higher level). The newest version unless you pass version. dv_proj_state lists the text nodes under texts. A read that writes no record.

path.description: The text node, as a relative path such as beats.md or episodes/ep001/script.md (no whitespace, @, # or .., no leading /, no empty or . part).

section.description: The text of a heading, without the # marks.

version.description: A version number; defaults to the newest version.

reason.description: Why you call this, in the user's words or your own summary; recorded as the intent of the record.

project_id.description: The project; defaults to this conversation's project from dv_proj_create or dv_proj_open.
